entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not sure how to put this...[n]but a lot of people here are[n]wearing strange attire.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I wonder where they even buy such[n]clothes... Regardless, is it okay to[n]walk around here for a while?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...So this is what "fashion" is.[n]I'm feeling some culture shock,[n]to be perfectly honest.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Everything is so different...[n]Makeup, manicures, dyed hair...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I always thought those things[n]were only for delinquents...
Why not try it out?
That's not necessarily true.[clr 27]
You should be a delinquent.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: T-True, I am interested...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I think I'd like to study about[n]these things a little more first...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait... I'll never be able to[n]change if I give up this easily.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I suppose you're right. That's[n]just the young fashion nowadays.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But aren't people of all ages[n]judging the style we express?[n]Not just young people...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait... That's a horrible excuse.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly, I... I want to try[n]being fashionable as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh!? I guess I wouldn't mind[n]being like them in some ways...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly, I... I want to try[n]being fashionable as well.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I want to do all the things I've[n]kept from myself. From now on, I[n]do what I want, for my own sake.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Though I'll also keep up with[n]my normal duties, of course.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *chuckle* Thank you for inviting[n]me here today. Being with you[n]gives me courage.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, I've been curious about[n]something... Do girls use makeup[n]to make themselves appear whiter?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Perhaps I'll give it a[n]try once I get home.
